name: MyWhoosh
note: Indoor cycling app headquartered in Masdar City, Abu Dhabi; on the back shoulders of the 2026 UAE Team Emirates XRG jersey and a listed main sponsor of both the men's team and UAE Team L'IMAD. Ownership not found in primary documents: DC Rainmaker (2022) writes that 'the lead/primary investor is the government of the UAE' and Cycling Weekly calls it 'backed by substantial UAE government support and funding' — neither source names the entity, so no claim is written.
